_comment: Central configuration for the local DeepSeek (llama.cpp) inference server. Never hardcode these values in engine code.

server._comment_context_size: Fallback only. The live value is auto-detected from GET /props and shown by --doctor. 1024 is NOT enough for a reasoning model: the model spends the whole window thinking and never answers.
server._comment_reasoning_budget: SERVER-SIDE ONLY. Passed as --reasoning-budget when starting llama-server. 0 disables DeepSeek-R1 chain-of-thought, which is required on this hardware: at 0 reasoning the model answers directly at the same speed but stops wasting the whole token budget on hidden thought. Per-request values are ignored by llama.cpp.
server._comment_auto_start: The app never launches llama-server automatically unless this is true. It always probes the base_url first.

request._comment_timeout: Generous because a 14B Q8 model runs at ~2.3 tokens/second on this machine.

reasoning._comment: DeepSeek-R1 style models may emit <think> blocks or a separate reasoning_content field. Both are stripped and never written into narration or production files.
reasoning._comment_min_context: The doctor command warns below this value.
